candidates.review_note: Represent each position as a directed edge from its desired value to its current value. This balanced multigraph decomposes into cycles; maximizing the number of cycles minimizes swaps. A most frequent value with multiplicity f forces at least f simple cycles, and the maximum possible sadness is n-f. If deleting that value leaves a directed cycle, extract it and then at least f more cycles, so sadness is smaller. If no such cycle remains, every simple cycle must contain that value and exactly f cycles are possible. Thus a linear-time topological cycle check after removing one most frequent value gives the criterion, retaining parallel edges and self-loops.
